main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of excess next-day return on post_pipeline_value
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess next-day return, top fifth of forecasts minus other bars (Welch t) [Welch t = 5.026]

decided_by: Slope positive with t >= 2 and top-fifth mean excess return larger with Welch t >= 2 (confirm rule).
reading: Top fifth taken as pooled bars with post_pipeline_value at or above its pooled 80th percentile; each coin's mean daily return is the mean of its next-bar returns over all its windows; the supporting check passes when the top-fifth mean is larger with Welch t >= 2, as the confirm rule needs.
